clips.title: The story
paras: At Red Cloud Mesa, Water Pitcher carries fresh spring water from the local well to Camp Narache. Greatmother Hawkwind asks young tauren to bring it back as a lesson in humility, service, and respect for tribal elders.

Water Pitcher rests beside the well southeast of Camp Narache. Greatmother Hawkwind asks a novice to fill it and carry it to Chief Hawkwind. The chore tests their character and teaches young braves that no duty is beneath a tribal protector. Caring for the everyday needs of their kin matters as much as wielding a weapon on the hunt.
